brief: Redesign the first screen of https://www.sweetspot.co.kr so it reads faster and feels more desirable, keeping brand and copy.

judge.reason: The oversized distorted wordmark creates a strong single focal point but destroys legibility and provides no value proposition, failing the faster and more desirable brief.

diagnosis: 얼굴 영역(FFA/STS)이 조용함: 사람·시선 단서가 없음
보상 회로(OFC/vmPFC)는 켜졌는데 끌림 헤드는 평범: 가치 신호가 있지만 무엇이 좋은지 읽히지 않음
물체 형태(LO)·움직임(MT) 반응이 낮음: 뚜렷한 사물 실루엣이 없는 텍스트 위주 화면
directives: Introduce a human cue: a portrait or illustrated face whose gaze points at the CTA/product (faces win attention fastest).
Name the value explicitly next to what the eye lands on: one benefit line + price/offer under the hero, nothing else competing.
Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
critique.prompt_block:
BRAIN CRITIQUE (TRIBE v2 predicted human cortex while looking at the last render; values are relative within this image):
- most driven regions: 시각 주의(IPS/FEF) +1.24, 보상·가치(OFC/vmPFC) +0.95, 장소·배경(PPA/RSC) +0.95; least: 움직임·형태(MT/LO) -1.25, 얼굴·사람(FFA/STS) -1.53
- first-2s hook vs later: attention +1.25 → +1.23, visual drive -0.33 → -0.26
- areas the aesthetic head cites: ▲ 우 후대상 기본모드 (23d) [aesthetic]; ▲ 우 두정내구 주의 (IP1) [aesthetic]; ▲ 1차 시각(V1–V4) 평균 [attention]; ▲ 움직임·형태(MT/LO) 평균 [attention]
- diagnosis: 얼굴 영역(FFA/STS)이 조용함: 사람·시선 단서가 없음 / 보상 회로(OFC/vmPFC)는 켜졌는데 끌림 헤드는 평범: 가치 신호가 있지만 무엇이 좋은지 읽히지 않음 / 물체 형태(LO)·움직임(MT) 반응이 낮음: 뚜렷한 사물 실루엣이 없는 텍스트 위주 화면
- DO NEXT (highest priority first): (1) Introduce a human cue: a portrait or illustrated face whose gaze points at the CTA/product (faces win attention fastest). (2) Name the value explicitly next to what the eye lands on: one benefit line + price/offer under the hero, nothing else competing. (3) Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
